cdif.bbr.metadata.cdifDataType.objectRef.title: Object Reference
cdif.bbr.metadata.cdifDataType.objectRef.description: A reference to a node defined elsewhere, by its @id.

cdif.bbr.metadata.bioschemasProperties.b.title: Bioschemas Sample properties
cdif.bbr.metadata.bioschemasProperties.b.description: Properties of a biological sample from the Bioschemas Sample draft (https://bioschemas.org/), in the bios: namespace. A node using them is typed with bios:Sample beside its own type. Every property accepts one value or an array, because framing collapses a one-element array to its value. Ranges follow the Bioschemas draft where it gives one, and allow text where real records use text for a term.

bios:anatomicalStructure.description: The organ or tissue the sample was collected from.

bios:anatomicalSystem.description: The anatomical system the sample was collected from, e.g. circulatory, digestive, immune.

bios:associatedPhenotype.description: Defining characteristics expressed by the biological source of the sample.

bios:collectionMethod.description: Conditions and methods of acquisition of the sample.

bios:collector.description: The Person or Organization who collected the sample.

bios:dateCollected.description: The date the sample was collected.

bios:dateProcessed.description: The date the sample was processed or used in a method.

bios:developmentalStage.description: The age or developmental stage of the source when the sample was created, as a term or a quantity.

bios:environmentalSystem.description: The habitat or ecosystem where the sample was collected.

bios:experimentalPurpose.description: The planned or executed experimental procedures involving the sample.

bios:isControl.description: Whether the sample is used as a normal control.

bios:locationOfOrigin.description: The location from which the sample was originally collected.

bios:sampleAvailability.description: Whether the sample is available for reuse.

bios:sampleProcess.description: The processing technique applied to the sample.

bios:sampleState.description: The condition, composition or state of the sample, e.g. dried, frozen.

bios:sampleStorageTemperature.description: The temperature at which the sample is stored.

bios:sampleType.description: The type of sample, intentionally broad (cells, rock, sand).

bios:sex.description: The biological sex of the individual the sample was obtained from.

bios:studyID.description: The identifier of the study the sample belongs to.

bios:studyTitle.description: The title of the study the sample belongs to.

bios:project.description: The project the sample belongs to.

term.description: A defined term, or a reference to one. It must name or identify the term.

quantity.description: A schema:QuantitativeValue; a range uses minValue and maxValue.

title: NIAID dataset properties
description: The properties NIAID Data Discovery Portal records add to a CDIF dataset (composed with cdifCore and cdifDiscovery by the cdifNIAID profile; this module does NOT re-embed them). nde: terms are NIAID's (https://discovery.biothings.io/ns/nde/), bios: terms Bioschemas' (from the bioschemasSample block), and cdifniaid: terms the ones the portal uses that neither vocabulary declares, defined by this block. Every property accepts one value or an array, because framing collapses a one-element array to its value.

items.description: uri for specifications that this metadata record conforms to

schema:includedInDataCatalog.description: The repositories holding the dataset, which the portal aggregates from.

nde:date.description: The portal's summary date for the record.

nde:species.description: Species the dataset was collected from or is about.

nde:topicCategory.description: Topics of the dataset, from the EDAM topic ontology.

schema:infectiousAgent.description: Infectious agents the dataset is about.

schema:healthCondition.description: Health conditions the dataset is about.

schema:measurementTechnique.description: NIAID's annotations on the measurement techniques CDIF discovery describes.

schema:variableMeasured.description: NIAID's annotations on the variables CDIF discovery describes.

schema:citation.description: NIAID's journal and PubMed details on CDIF's citations.

nde:curatedBy.description: Who curated the record, and from which version of their catalog.

nde:isRelatedTo.description: Related resources, with the relationship named.

nde:sample.description: The samples used to generate the dataset, or a collection of them.

schema:funding.description: NIAID's grant details on CDIF's funding.

schema:spatialCoverage.description: NIAID's location details on CDIF's spatial coverage.

schema:sourceOrganization.description: Projects and programs the dataset comes from.

bios:alternateIdentifier.description: Identifiers beyond the one CDIF's schema:identifier holds.

cdifniaid:temporalIntervals.description: The portal's temporal intervals where they hold more than dates, kept whole beside schema:temporalCoverage.

cdifniaid:unlinkedHasPart.description: Parts of the dataset with no address, which cannot be CDIF manifest parts.

cdifniaid:assayformat.description: The assay format, as the portal gives it.

cdifniaid:publication.description: PubMed identifiers of publications about the dataset.

schema:distribution.description: NIAID's archive members that come with an address only.

annotation.description: NIAID's annotations on a term: whether it was curated, by whom, the text it was matched from, and which method produced it.

cdifniaid:fromGPT.description: The term was suggested by a GPT language model.

cdifniaid:fromPMID.description: The term was taken from a PubMed record linked to the dataset.

cdifniaid:fromEXTRACT.description: The term was found by the EXTRACT text-mining tool.

cdifniaid:fromNCT.description: The term was taken from the dataset's ClinicalTrials.gov record.

cdifniaid:classification.description: The role a taxon plays for the dataset, e.g. infectiousAgent or host.

cdifniaid:commonName.description: The common name of a taxon.

cdifniaid:displayName.description: The name the portal displays for a taxon.

cdifniaid:partUrl.description: URLs of files in the archive, given with no name or format, so they cannot be CDIF archive parts.

nde:relationship.description: How the resource is related, e.g. "has part" or "is part of".

cdifniaid:alternateNames.description: An agent's second and later alternate names; schema:alternateName holds the first.

projectNumber.description: The parts of an NIH project number such as 5R01AI012345-03, which NIH grant identifiers follow.

cdifniaid:applTypeCode.description: Application type, e.g. 5 for a non-competing continuation.

cdifniaid:icCode.description: The NIH institute or center, e.g. AI for NIAID.

cdifniaid:fullSupportYear.description: Year of support with any suffix.

cdifniaid:suffixCode.description: Suffix, e.g. S1 for a supplement.

cdifniaid:country.description: The country the place is in.

cdifniaid:correctionApproved.description: A correction to the portal's record of the project has been approved.

sample.description: A sample; nde:Sample is NIAID's subclass of the Bioschemas sample.

sampleCollection.description: A collection of samples, which NIAID types as an ItemList.
